title: Deduplicate the copy-pasted cause-suffix toString() snippet across 3 sync exception classes
rule: Fowler duplication (digest lens pass) — Extract Method / Pull Up Field
why: The identical ternary-interpolation snippet is hand-copied into 3 of the 4 exception classes in this directory (SyncPushException uses a 4th, differently-shaped cause format). Each also hand-declares its own nullable cause field because their respective category bases (PermissionException, InternalException) don't carry one — only NetworkException does, per app_exception.dart's hierarchy. If cause-formatting ever needs to change — e.g. to redact a PII-bearing FirebaseException payload before it reaches AppLogger/Crashlytics, a real concern given this app's child-privacy posture — a maintainer has to remember to update 3+ near-identical copies instead of one, and any future 5th leaf exception is likely to copy the same snippet again.
recommendation: Extract a shared `causeSuffix` getter (or mixin) that formats cause consistently, or lift a cause field plus a shared toString helper onto AppException itself so leaf exceptions compose it instead of reimplementing the ternary.
acceptance_criteria: no more than one definition of the `cause != null ? ... : ''` formatting logic remains under lib/core/sync/exceptions/ and lib/core/exceptions/

corrections: OutboxDeadLetterException does not hand-declare its own `cause` field — it inherits it from NetworkException via `super.cause` in the constructor. Only FirestorePermissionDeniedException and MergeException hand-declare, since PermissionException/InternalException lack a cause field. 'Each' in the why-text overstates this for the 3rd site.
